verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Balances API for real-time/historical balance data and a Settlement Report that gives a full breakdown of a payout to help reconcile transactions, and these are also exposed via the official MCP server (Balances, Settlements APIs) so an agent could pull this data programmatically via natural language or direct API/OAuth access. However, there is no documented dedicated 'balance transactions' endpoint or example showing line-item-level linking of each charge to its deposit, and no hands-on/independent evidence of an agent actually performing end-to-end reconciliation. missing for 10: a documented balance-transactions/line-item API distinct from settlement reports, worked example or independent case study of automated deposit-to-charge reconciliation via API/agent, and confirmation that Settlements API data via MCP includes per-charge granularity.
